Visible titles include: “Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “Compound Effect”, “Zero One”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “This Is Marketing”, “Seth Godin”, “How to Speak and Think”, “Women Rise Up!”, “Sell Like Crazy”, “Bring Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “Words Matter”, “Midas Touch”, “Spiritual Authority”, and others.
Photo 1 shows more of the same set of books; spines/covers are visible but not all titles are fully readable.
No scale, no weight certificate, and no proof of total quantity (count) is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: photo 0 and photo 1 show multiple books with motivational/business/relationship/self-development titles.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: photos show books on a floor but do not clearly confirm dryness/absence of water damage or sorting quality.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: no scale, no certified scale label, and no weighing receipt/photo is provided.

risks.risk: Weight/quantity may be overstated (500 kg is unusually high for a small set of visible books).
risks.proof: A clear video/photo of the books on a scale showing the reading, plus a close-up of the scale model/certification label and the weighing timestamp.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller bundle of used books (worst case: not 500 kg).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than claimed (water damage, missing pages, torn covers, stains).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of 3–5 random books showing: cover edges, spine, and inside pages (open to a random page) plus a photo of any damaged/marked copies.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used books with possible wear (worst case: some may be damaged).

risks.risk: Completeness may be uncertain (some books may be missing from the bundle or replaced with different editions).
risks.proof: A numbered inventory list (or video pan) showing each book title/edition clearly, matching what is being sold.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an incomplete/uncertain bundle (worst case: not all titles/editions are included).

risks.risk: Edition/printing quality affects resale value (some may be older/low-demand editions).
risks.proof: Photos of the copyright/edition page for 2–3 representative books (front matter) and the ISBN if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used copies without premium editions.

proof_requests: Send a photo/video of the weighing: books on the scale with the exact reading visible, plus a close-up of the certified scale label and the weighing receipt (if any).
Send a clear count: either a video showing the full stack with titles visible, or a spreadsheet/photo inventory of each book in the bundle.
Send condition proof: close-ups of 3–5 random books (spine, cover corners, and an opened inside page) to confirm no water damage and no missing pages.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a bundle of motivational/business/relationship/self-development books, but the key pricing driver (the claimed 500 kg on a certified scale) is not verifiable from the provided images, and condition/quantity completeness are also not proven.
